scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run setup --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix backend && npm run build
